race4_note: Race 4 (9 Sep) is scored on cncascais.com but still has no ib-sailing wind/bias analysis page and no synced team telemetry, so it is not in the race explorer or the bias calibration table. Overnight the scored results were amended: Garm's race 4 went from 48th to 50th (total 131->133 pts, overall 27th->29th of 100), and Another Affair's race 3 moved 19th->20th (46->47 pts) -- a reminder that early-posted results can still move.

telemetry.note: Decoded 9 Sep from ~/Downloads/Sailing Files. Two byte-identical duplicates skipped. Day assigned from the decoded timestamps, not the filenames — the download scrambled those, and several boats have a higher-numbered file for the EARLIER day.

event.entries_note: The event report gives both "99 boats" and "a fleet of 100 boats"; the scored results list 100. The 34 that appear repeatedly here are the subset the event publishes race analysis for, not the fleet.

gain_def: Places won between the first windward mark and the finish — the estimated Windward 1 position minus the official finish, summed over the races.
